name: Celtic Mahjong Solitaire 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Celtic Mahjong Solitaire is a mahjong game with a Solitaire variation ruleset. Match tiles with each other to remove them from the board, but make sure that both tiles have a free space on either their left or right side (you won't be able to highlight them otherwise as it's an invalid move).
